title.vi: Hàm chuỗi: làm sạch và tách văn bản
title.en: String functions: cleaning and splitting text

summary.vi: UPPER, LENGTH, SUBSTR, INSTR, REPLACE, TRIM, nối chuỗi, LIKE
summary.en: UPPER, LENGTH, SUBSTR, INSTR, REPLACE, TRIM, concatenation, LIKE

files.name: query.sql
files.code:
SELECT
  name,
  UPPER(name)                                  AS upper_name,
  LENGTH(name)                                 AS len,
  SUBSTR(email, INSTR(email, '@') + 1)         AS email_domain,
  REPLACE(city, ' ', '_')                      AS city_slug,
  name || ' <' || COALESCE(email, 'n/a') || '>' AS label
FROM customers
ORDER BY name;

prompt.vi: Với bảng customers có email, trả về name và domain (phần sau dấu @), sắp xếp theo name. Bỏ qua khách không có email.
prompt.en: From customers that have an email, return name and domain (the part after @), sorted by name. Skip customers without an email.

hint.vi: SUBSTR(email, INSTR(email, '@') + 1) và WHERE email IS NOT NULL.
hint.en: SUBSTR(email, INSTR(email, '@') + 1) and WHERE email IS NOT NULL.

solution.name: query.sql
solution.code:
SELECT name, SUBSTR(email, INSTR(email, '@') + 1) AS domain
FROM customers
WHERE email IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY name;

prompt.vi: Từ bảng products, trả về UPPER(name) và LENGTH(name) cho các sản phẩm có tên dài hơn 5 ký tự, sắp xếp theo name.
prompt.en: From products, return UPPER(name) and LENGTH(name) for products whose name is longer than 5 characters, sorted by name.

solution.name: query.sql
solution.code:
SELECT UPPER(name), LENGTH(name)
FROM products
WHERE LENGTH(name) > 5
ORDER BY name;
